ops.oldText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
ops.newText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor, provided that Licensor shall not request more than one (1) such audit in any twelve (12) month period, and each such audit shall be conducted during Licensee's normal business hours and subject to the confidentiality obligations of this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a once-per-twelve-months cap, business-hours limitation and confidentiality condition on the audit right, as the clause is currently unlimited in frequency; our playbook permits audits no more than once per 12 months on written notice. The existing independent-auditor selection and Licensor-borne cost (subject to a 5% discrepancy) work for us and are unchanged.
input.summary: Cap usage audits at once per 12 months, during business hours and subject to confidentiality.
